'''Jean Berstel''' (born 1941) is a French [[mathematician]] and [[Theoretical computer science|theoretical computer scientist]] known for his contributions to [[combinatorics on words]] and [[formal language theory]]. He is currently a professor emeritus at the [[University of Marne-la-Vallée]].

==Biography==
Berstel earned his doctorate (doctorat d'État) at [[Paris Diderot University]] in 1973. In 1973–1995 he was a professor at [[Pierre and Marie Curie University]], and in 1995–2005 a professor at the [[University of Marne-la-Vallée]], where he has been a professor emeritus since 2005.

In 2006, Berstel was awarded an honorary doctorate from the [[University of Turku]], [[Finland]]. A festschrift in his honour was published in 2003 as a special issue of [[Theoretical Computer Science (journal)|''Theoretical Computer Science'']].<ref name="Séébold2003">{{cite journal|last1=Séébold|first1=Patrice|title=Foreword|journal=Theoretical Computer Science|volume=292|issue=1|year=2003|pages=1|issn=0304-3975|doi=10.1016/S0304-3975(01)00210-9|doi-access=}}</ref>

==Research contributions==
Berstel has been a member of the [[M. Lothaire|Lothaire]] group of mathematicians that developed the foundations of combinatorics of words. He has published several scientific monographs, including
''Transductions and Context-free Languages'' (1979),<ref>{{cite book | last1=Berstel | first1=Jean | title=Transductions and Context-free Languages | publisher=Treubner Verlag| isbn=978-3-519-02340-1 | year=1979 | doi=10.1007/978-3-663-09367-1}}</ref>
''Theory of Codes'' (1985, jointly with [[Dominique Perrin]]),<ref>{{cite book | last1=Berstel | first1=Jean | last2=Perrin | first2=Dominique | title=Theory of Codes | publisher=Academic Press | series=Pure and Applied Mathematics | isbn=978-0-120-93420-1 | year=1985 | volume=117}}</ref> and ''Codes and Automata'' (2009; jointly with [[Dominique Perrin]] and Christophe Reutenauer)<ref>{{cite book | last1=Berstel | first1=Jean | last2=Perrin | first2=Dominique | last3=Reutenauer | first3=Christophe | title=Codes and Automata | publisher=Cambridge University Press | series=Encyclopedia of Mathematics and its Applications | isbn=978-0-521-88831-8 | year=2009 | volume=129}}</ref>
as well as the three [[M. Lothaire|Lothaire books]].<ref>{{cite book | last1=Lothaire | first1=M. | editor=<!-- none, bad meta-data--> | title=Combinatorics on Words | doi=10.1017/CBO9780511566097 | publisher=Addison-Wesley Publishing Co., Reading, Mass. | series=Encyclopedia of Mathematics and its Applications | isbn=978-0-201-13516-9 | mr=675953 | year=1983 | volume=17 | url-access=registration | url=https://archive.org/details/combinatoricsonw0000loth }}</ref><ref>{{cite book | last1=Lothaire | first1=M. | title=Algebraic Combinatorics on Words | url=https://archive.org/details/algebraiccombina0000loth | publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]] | series=Encyclopedia of Mathematics and its Applications | isbn=978-0-521-81220-7 | mr=1905123 | year=2002 | volume=90 | url-access=registration }}</ref><ref>{{cite book | last1=Lothaire | first1=M. | title=Applied Combinatorics on Words | url=https://archive.org/details/appliedcombinato0000loth | publisher=[[Cambridge University Press]] | series=Encyclopedia of Mathematics and its Applications | isbn=978-0-521-84802-2 | mr=2165687 | year=2005 | volume=105 | url-access=registration }}</ref>
